Name: Aimon's Witchy Dirt and Grass Recolor
Author: Aimon111
Description:
[font=Comic Sans MS][size=3][center][color=#fff2cc][b]Ever wished to have witchy looking dirt and grass in your game? Thanks to some requests from the people this mod exists now!.[/b][/color]

This recolor idea came from my other [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27631]Swamp Farm[/url] mod which changed grass and dirt in Farm map. With this mod hovewer you can now turn entrie valley into witchy swamp!
Big thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/68674623]Wildflourmods[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/210387900]BogWyytch[/url] for inspiring and encouraging me to do this mod! (Go check their amazing mods rn!)[/center][/size]

[b][u][color=#ffe599][size=3]What this mod does exactly:[/size][/color][/u][/b]
[list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=2]This mod recolors vanilla Grass and Dirt textures in the valley for Spring, Summer and Fall seasons (doesn't affect Ginger Island)[/size][/font]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=2]There's 2 color variations - Green and Purple (and also additional Brown and Bog's Gray for fall season)[/size][/font]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=2]Each recolor is fully configurable - you can toggle grass and dirt recolors separately for each season (spring, summer, fall). Use GMCM to toggle those configs ingame.[/size][/font]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=2]This mod is compatible with other recolors/retextures like Starblue, Vibrant Pastoral, ect...[/size][/font]
[/list][list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=2]This mod only affects Grass and Dirt textures - it doesn't touch Cliff, Water, Foliage or Buildings textures. This way you can combine and mixmatch it with any other recolor/retexture mod. This mod only adds recolors for Spring, Summer and Fall seasons - it doesn't add Winter themed recoloring at all.[/size][/font]
[/list][size=2]
[color=#ffe599][u][b]Supported Mods & Tilesheets:[/b][/u][/color]

[list]
[*][size=2]Stardew Valley Expanded[/size]
[*][size=2]Alvadea's Tilesheets[/size]
[*][size=2]DaisyNiko's Tilesheets[/size]
[*][size=2]Lumisteria Tilesheets - Outdoor[/size]
[*][size=2]MixedBag's Tilesheets[/size]
[*][size=2]Xiddav's Tilesheet[/size]
[/list][/size]
[color=#b6d7a8][size=3][b][u]Installation:[/u][/b][/size][/color]
[/font][list=1]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=2]Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3231]Farm Type Manager[/url]﻿﻿[/size][/font]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=2](Optional) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿[/size][/font]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=2]Unzip "[CP] Aimon's Witchy Dirt&Grass Recolor" archive into Stardew\Mods folder.[/size][/font]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=2]Run the game using SMAPI.[/size][/font]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=2]Enjoy.[/size][/font]
[/list][font=Comic Sans MS]

[color=#b6d7a8][size=3][b][u]Config:[/u][/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=2]Spring Dirt - Green, Purple, None[/size][/font]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=2]Summer Dirt-  Green, Purple, None[/size][/font]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=2]Fall Dirt -  Green, Purple, Brown, Gray, None[/size][/font]
[*][size=2]Tilted Dirt Color - Green, Purple, None[/size]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=2]Spring Grass -  Green, Purple, None[/size][/font]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=2]Summer Grass -  Green, Purple, None[/size][/font]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=2]Fall Grass -  Green, Purple, Brown, Gray, None[/size][/font]
[/list]

[size=3][u]i18n is supported! Currently added Chinese and Russian translation [/u][u] (Big thanks to passersby10086!)[/u]
[/size]
